en.ammaar-muslim: 9. [9/-] Tafsir Al-Ayyashi: From Safwan who said:
I asked Aba al-Hasan al-Rida عليه السلام about the words of Allah: “so wash your faces and your hands with the elbows and wipe part of your head and feet to the ankles” [5:6]
– he said: a man asked Aba al-Hasan (al-Kadhim) عليه السلام about this so he said: Surat al-Maida is enough for you – meaning – wiping the head and the two feet …
